proposals.title: Separate graph topology gains from smoothing and model capacity
proposals.claim: A matched ablation suite can falsify attribution of future predictive gains to biological graph topology when feature-only or fixed-smoothing controls reproduce them.
proposals.mechanism: Compare neighborhood_mmd, mmd_u and de_direction under whole-embryo splits with equal sampling: MLP, coordinate MLP, fixed smoothing, shallow GNN and rewired edges. Improvement only over an unmatched MLP cannot establish useful topology.
proposals.falsifier: Once lawful data exist, matched controls reproduce the GNN metric delta within embryo-level uncertainty; decline topology-benefit attribution. No empirical biological comparison is possible now.

evidence.says: Requests graph variants and comparison of absent versus known biological prior; reports no executed outcome.

evidence.ref: Wu et al., Simplifying Graph Convolutional Networks, ICML 2019, https://proceedings.mlr.press/v97/wu19e.html
evidence.says: A fixed low-pass filter plus linear classifier can retain performance in studied applications; motivates a smoothing control.

proposals.title: Make edge provenance and cavity shortcuts explicit validation gates
proposals.claim: An edge provenance audit plus hollow-shell synthetic check will expose target-derived graph inputs and Euclidean kNN cavity shortcuts before biological model training.
proposals.mechanism: Record split-specific inputs and graph rules; prohibit truth-derived preprocessing or edges entering prediction. Test ordinary versus radius-limited mutual kNN on a shell. This protects interpretation of neighborhood_mmd rather than asserting a score gain.
proposals.falsifier: An intentionally injected held-out-derived edge source passes the audit, or a known cavity-crossing edge is not detected by the synthetic diagnostic; then the proposed gate is inadequate.

evidence.says: GNN review explicitly covers graph construction, spatial graphs, graph leakage, oversmoothing and topology sensitivity.
Lists sample, animal, spatial-neighborhood, normalization, PCA and external-dataset leakage risks.

evidence.ref: Roohani et al., GEARS, Nature Biotechnology online 2023 / volume 2024, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-023-01905-6
evidence.says: Uses distinct coexpression and GO graphs; poorly connected unseen perturbation genes limit predictions.

peer_responses.on: spatial3d-r1-1 scorer conformance and spatial3d-r1-2 provenance gates
peer_responses.because: Endorse gates, but descriptor invariance cannot establish cavity or laterality preservation. Missing scorer imports (Neurl IPS 2026/agent_orchestrator.py:27-28) require separate labelled shell, coverage and boundary diagnostics before anatomical attribution.

declined: Immediate deep spatial GNN or GEARS adoption: no data or implementation supports benefit; cavity shortcuts, oversmoothing, sparse perturbation supervision and prior exposure must be audited first. Historical killed-kNN assertions are unverified.
